title: Analytics Engineer
description:
Analytics Engineer | Tech Ops | Hybrid Working | Hatfield

Introduction:

We are Ocado Group, and we're bringing world-class automation to online grocery. Our Ocado Smart Platform (OSP) combines cutting-edge robotics, AI, and IoT within our advanced CFCs (Customer Fulfilment Centres). We've mastered the single pick, transforming online delivery for our global partners. Join us and be part of a team pushing the boundaries of retail technology.

About the Role:

As an Analytics Engineer for Tech Ops and OMRS, you will bridge the gap between data producers and data consumers, transforming complex data from our robotics and automated systems into trusted, certified data foundations. Focusing on bot, grid, and maintenance telemetry, you will design reporting layers in dbt and implement standardized definitions in the semantic layer to ensure metrics remain consistent across all dashboards, analysts, and AI tools.

In this role, you will act as the key liaison between Data Engineering and business analysts, establishing robust data models and governing metric changes. You will play a pivotal role in enabling self-service analytics, triaging domain requests, and using modern AI-assisted engineering tools to build reliable, high-performing data pipelines that support our global operations.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Build and maintain layered dbt models in BigQuery, balancing query performance with long-term maintainability.
  • Implement and govern standardized business metrics within the dbt semantic layer (MetricFlow).
  • Migrate existing metric logic into the semantic layer while resolving data duplication.
  • Elevate analyst workflows into certified, production-ready reporting marts with full documentation and lineage.
  • Implement automated data quality testing and monitoring, escalating issues to upstream data producers.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Studytube maakt professionele ontwikkeling toegankelijk. Achter het platform zit een groeiende stroom leerdata. Die moet klanten, de business en de AI-features die we bouwen écht verder helpen. Daar zoeken we een Data Engineer voor die de datalaag bezit.
 De rol
 Je komt in een klein datateam binnen Product & Tech en rapporteert aan de Head of Engineering. Je werk bedient twee takken. Business: rapportages voor commerce, management en investeerders. Product: de inzichten die klanten in het platform zien, zoals voortgang en budget. Collega’s bouwen de dashboards, jij zorgt dat de data eronder klopt en meebeweegt met het product.
 Je werkt dagelijks samen met een businessanalist en een productanalist, die ook met Looker en dbt werkt. Er komt nog een analist bij. Een ervaren data engineer sluit één dag per week aan en een Data Lead staat op de planning.
 Wat je doet
 Je bent eigenaar van het Snowflake-platform: rollen en rechten, warehouse sizing en provisioning, tasks en kosten.
 Je beheert GitHub voor het dataplatform: branches, environments en automatisering met GitHub Actions.
 Je neemt Databricks, opgezet voor een high-security omgeving, over van een externe partij en bereidt de migratie van Snowflake naar Databricks voor, gepland voor volgend jaar.
 Je bouwt pipelines die incrementeel, idempotent, getest en gedocumenteerd zijn, en ontsluit bronnen via Fivetran of custom connectors.
 Je zorgt dat dbt Cloud betrouwbaar draait: afhankelijkheden, scheduling en failure handling.
 Je bewaakt freshness, volume en schema drift, en zoekt de root cause als iets breekt.
 Je ruimt de architectuur op, maakt het platform uitbreidbaar en bouwt GDPR-bewust: toegang, retentie en verwijdering zitten in het ontwerp.
 Je legt het fundament voor metrics waar sales, marketing en product op sturen, in plaats van handmatige Excels.
 Wie je bent
 Je hebt 3 tot 6 jaar productie-ervaring als data engineer. Je hebt de valkuilen al eens gezien en levert zonder platformteam achter je een get…

title: Analytics Engineer – Client Reporting
description:
Studytube makes professional development accessible. Our customers use client reporting, the insights they see in the platform, to understand how their people learn and to show the impact of their learning programmes. Those numbers have to be right, every time.
 We are looking for an Analytics Engineer dedicated to client reporting. You build and maintain the dbt models and Looker reports behind it. Over the coming year we are moving from Snowflake to Databricks, and you help bring client reporting to the new platform.
 What you'll do Build and maintain the dbt models behind client reporting, following our layered structure from source to report.
 Develop Looker reporting end to end: LookML views and explores, dashboards embedded in our platform, and the client-specific logic behind them.
 Turn client and Customer Success requests into reports, and push back when a definition or requirement is unclear.
 Keep client reporting reliable: tests, monitoring, documentation, code review and CI as the standard.
 Protect client data: access per client, privacy and GDPR built into every model and report.
 Work with our data engineer on the ingestion syncs (today Fivetran) that feed client reporting.
 Help migrate client reporting models from Snowflake to Databricks, including clients with specific data residency needs.
 Align client metrics with the shared definitions in our central data foundation, so customers and internal teams see the same numbers.
 Your team You join the Client Reporting team, where client reporting is your full-time focus. The team includes a Product Manager, a dedicated QA engineer and another analytics engineer.
 You work closely with the Product department, Customer Success and our central data team, so client reporting fits the product and answers what our customers need.
